limitations: Matched CPU benchmarks use synthetic complete-game mechanics, not prediction accuracy evidence. Real CFB normalization and isolated cache tests are identified separately.

The observability CPU query API rejected the attempted queries; no total-account CPU saving is inferred from log-line counts.
